gripOrHq.title: Project Venice
gripOrHq.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Chicago Branch
gripOrHq.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Project Zurich
gripOrHq.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

heapOrArchives.title: Bizarre Encryption Scheme
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Bizarre Encryption Scheme may only be installed in a subsidiary data fort. Runner does not score any agenda (or agendas) that he or she accesses from this fort; return the agenda to the fort instead. Runner scores the agenda at the start of his or her next turn if it is still in the fort.

heapOrArchives.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

discardCards.title: All-Hands
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, access three additional cards from HQ. You cannot use noisy icebreakers during the run.

discardCards.title: Promises, Promises
discardCards.rulesText: The next time you access an agenda this turn, score 1 additional agenda point.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Downsizing
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

rig.title: Psychic Friend
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break code gate subroutine. [2]: +1 strength until end of turn

rig.title: R&D-Protocol Files
rig.rulesText: A: Make a run on R&D, but instead of accessing cards, look at the top five cards of R&D.

rig.title: Bodyweight™ Data Crèche
rig.rulesText: Provides +1 MU. Once per turn, right after making a successful run, you can choose to make another run without taking an action to do so. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.
